title: Unsafe deserialization via binary_to_term (erlang) — review required
description: The erlang sink binary_to_term rebuilds objects from bytes, and hostile bytes can instantiate dangerous classes or run callbacks during decoding. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms the input source is trusted or switches to a data-only format.
remediation: Decode untrusted input with binary_to_term/2 with the [safe] option instead of object deserialization. If object graphs are required, sign the bytes and verify before decoding.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any binary_to_term call matches, including decoding of trusted local state. Trust in the byte source needs human review.
